title: Validate and Harden Batch/Cache Recommendation Engine with Staged Fail-safes and Forensics
creator: Maya Patel
description: After the February incident where a miscalibrated caching recommendation caused latency regressions for a subset of tenants, we need a structured validation and hardening effort for the batch/cache recommendation engine. This ticket scopes the infra + runtime + ops work to: 1) build an offline / shadow validation harness for candidate recommendations, 2) add staged apply gates (dry-run, score threshold, shadow-canary, limited-tenant canary), 3) define precise telemetry-based rollback triggers and an automated safe-apply flow with kill-switch, and 4) create forensic artifacts and post-apply verification checks for faster postmortem and automated rollback if regressions appear. The aim is to make recommendation-driven config changes safe to auto-apply while preserving cost savings benefits.
acceptance_criteria: Offline validation harness can replay 7 days of production traces and produce a delta report (cost, latency, error-rate) for any candidate recommendation
Staged apply pipeline exists: dry-run -> shadow-canary (10% traffic) -> limited-tenant canary (config pinned to 3 tenants) -> full apply
Automated rollback triggers implemented: serving.latency.p99 > baseline*1.15 OR error_rate_increment > 0.5% OR tail-kv-cache-miss-rate > baseline + 5%
Recommendation objects include a confidence_score and expected_cost_savings field surfaced in the console and telemetry
Runbook and dashboard links added to operator playbooks; runbook tested in an on-call drill
At least one end-to-end PR merged (infra + runtime + console) and an internal demo completed with PM and SRE approval
updates: 2026-03-01: Kickoff meeting with Optimize, Runtime, and SRE. Agreed scope and SLOs for safe-apply gating.

2026-03-04: Prototype offline replay harness (python) that replays token-level routing and KV-cache hit/miss stats against historical traces (github.com/redwood-inference/optimize/replay-proto PR #1287).

2026-03-06: Defined preliminary rollback thresholds with SRE: p99 latency +15%, 95th percentile latency +12%, user-visible 5xx increase of 0.25%. These are conservative and can be tuned after 2 canaries.
2026-03-09: Instrumentation added to runtime: optimize.reco.confidence, optimize.reco.expected_delta_cost, and optimize.apply_session_id tags (PR #1302).
2026-03-11: Security review requested for recommendation metadata in telemetry (security ticket SEC-213). SRE flagged access control for apply tokens.
2026-03-12: Demo for PM & SRE: Shadow-canary proof-of-concept completed. Next: integrate automated rollback action in orchestrator and add audit entries to console UI.
implementation_notes: Offline validation should compute both token-level and route-level deltas: per-route p50/p95/p99 latency, per-tenant cost delta, and KV-cache hit-rate delta.
Recommendation object schema upgrade: add fields confidence_score (0-100), expected_cost_savings_usd, validation_status (pending|pass|fail), and validation_artifact_url.

Canary staging plan: shadow-canary (mirror request to new config, no response delivered, collect metrics for 24h), then limited-tenant canary (switch 3 non-critical tenants for 6h), then stepwise ramp with automatic verify intervals.

Rollback action: orchestrator will issue a 2-phase rollback: immediate rollback of serving configuration + deactivate recommendation, followed by a postmortem capture job which snapshots logs, traces, and the replay harness inputs for analysis.
Operator controls: UI button to 'force-fail' a recommendation (instant rollback + annotate), and audit log entry for any auto-apply events.
Metrics naming: use optimize.reco.apply.latency_delta_p99, optimize.reco.apply.error_rate_delta_5xx, optimize.reco.apply.cache_miss_delta for alerting and SLO checks.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Offline replay mismatches production behavior due to non-deterministic tokenization or dynamic routing. Mitigation: include randomized seed and live-shadowing as mandatory gate.
Risk: Overly-conservative rollback thresholds prevent cost savings. Mitigation: tunable thresholds with a calibration window and A/B analysis to adjust thresholds per-tenancy class.
Risk: Recommendation metadata leaks sensitive routing info. Mitigation: redact PII and restrict telemetry to internal roles; security review SEC-213 in progress.
Risk: Auto-apply failures cause cascading rollbacks. Mitigation: implement backoff + alerting to human-on-call and stop further auto-applies until triage completes.
